acceptance: Only Known facts with a validated-evidence identity (kind beginning with evidence_) render in the reader-facing 已确认信息 / Confirmed Information section.

Known SEC metric facts, source observations, pending_evidence facts, and generic legacy facts remain available to the input, snapshot, health, and judgment paths but do not render as confirmed evidence.
The executive summary count and primary-evidence sentence use the same validated-evidence boundary and do not count raw SEC or source facts.
The system-health Known-fact count is explicitly labeled as known facts in Chinese, Japanese, and English so it cannot be read as validated evidence.
Focused regressions prove raw known facts are excluded, validated evidence is included, and the existing acquisition/judgment/persistence behavior remains unchanged.
Weekly Radar operations documentation describes the reader-facing distinction between SourceObservation, DocumentCandidate, ValidatedEvidence, known facts, and confirmed information.
All required local governance, quality, and project tests pass before the Work Item is finished.
guidelines: Keep raw NormalizedFact values in the input and snapshot for judgment and audit; change only reader-facing report selection and labels.
Use the existing evidence_ identity as the promotion boundary; do not add a new provider-specific or persisted schema field.
Preserve deterministic ordering, all three report languages, and no-ranking behavior.
Do not import internal modules from other features or add dependencies.
Do not weaken or delete existing tests; update only assertions whose old confirmed-information semantics are intentionally corrected.

intent.problem: The post-merge Weekly Radar dry-run produced 59 Known facts under the reader-facing 已确认信息 section, including SEC metrics and raw engineering-page observations. The new claim gate created 8 validated evidence records, but the report renderer still promoted every Known non-source fact by status alone, so source availability and financial baseline facts were being presented as enterprise-change evidence.
constraints: Only report semantics and regression coverage are in scope; acquisition, document discovery, claim extraction, judgment inputs, ranking, persistence, and delivery remain unchanged.
A validated evidence fact is identified by FactStatus::Known plus a kind beginning with evidence_; raw facts must remain in the runtime input and serialized snapshot.
Keep the report deterministic and preserve Chinese, Japanese, and English output contracts.
No new dependency, schema migration, provider call, or production delivery operation.
intent.rationale: The existing evidence promotion path already emits a stable evidence_ identity. Reusing that boundary in the report is the smallest change that makes the reader-facing claim semantics match the actual ingestion pipeline while preserving raw facts for judgment and audit.
